## The workflow

<Steps>
<Step title="Create an inbox">
Every test gets its own address. A short `ttl` keeps the sandbox clean.
</Step>
<Step title="Trigger your application">
Use the inbox address wherever your application would send email.
</Step>
<Step title="Wait for an email">
[Wait for message](/api/inboxes/wait-for-message) blocks until a matching message arrives.
</Step>
<Step title="Assert its contents">
Read the parsed body, links, and attachments from the [message](/api/messages/get-message).
</Step>
</Steps>

## Install

<CodeGroup>
```bash title="npm"
npm install @testinbox/client
```
```bash title="pnpm"
pnpm add @testinbox/client
```
</CodeGroup>
